note: This file MUST be committed before any scoring runs. The freeze ordering is provable from git commit times. Any threshold edit after a number is seen invalidates the run.

absolute_bar.note: LABEL_SOUND iff n_scored > 0 AND n_supported == n_scored (support_rate == 1.0). NOT_APPLICABLE is NOT a pass.

regression_verdict.predicate: lineage := (set(per_bundle) == {de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica}) AND (n_scored == 65); FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND n_supported < 5; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND NOT FAIL; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage
regression_verdict.note: Regression comparison applies ONLY to the incumbent 65-row population. On v3 packet (n_scored=0), regression_verdict will be NOT_APPLICABLE, which certifies NOTHING about label soundness.

population_free_label_lineage_gate.note: The accepted population-free label_lineage_gate instrument's build-blocking FAIL_REGRESSION behavior at any scored population, published beside the population-pinned label_gate verdict with NOT_APPLICABLE never counted as a pass.

COHERENCE_QUERY_LANG.definition: Per-cluster share of rows whose language == bundle query language, vs bundle baseline share. Dominant cluster = largest shipped cluster.

COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM.bar: dominant-cluster query-term hit rate >= bundle baseline hit rate
COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM.definition: Share of rows whose body text contains >=1 frozen query-term lexicon entry (casefold substring).

PROJ_RANK.definition: Spearman correlation between distance-to-query-vector (TF-IDF cosine) and retrieval rank (shipped x/y geometry).

PROJ_SPEARMAN.definition: Spearman between shipped 2-D Euclidean distances and TF-IDF cosine distances over sampled pairs.

PROJ_KNN10.definition: Mean kNN@10 overlap between 2-D Euclidean neighborhoods and TF-IDF cosine neighborhoods (shipped x/y).

STRUCTURE_LARGEST.definition: No single group may swallow the map.

STRUCTURE_SEP.definition: Mean intra-cluster cosine distance / mean inter-cluster cosine distance (TF-IDF, shipped assignment).

LABEL_CONTENT_FRACTION.definition: Fraction of label terms (all clusters pooled) that are neither stopwords (qmap STOPWORDS) nor BGE/ATF citation fragments (CIT_RE).

LABEL_JACCARD.bar: mean pairwise Jaccard between cluster label term sets <= 0.50, and distinct labels == n_clusters
LABEL_JACCARD.definition: Labels must discriminate groups, not repeat the same vocabulary.

OUTLIER_VALIDITY.bar: PASS iff (outlier mean shared-citation degree < non-outlier mean) AND (Jaccard(outliers, bottom-decile-by-rank) < 1.0). DEGENERATE->FAIL if citation graph empty.
OUTLIER_VALIDITY.definition: Outliers are weakly connected decisions worth inspecting, not merely the rank tail.

RELATIONS.bar: edge count >= 10 AND >= 90% of edge endpoints exist as bundle rows AND every edge carries kind
RELATIONS.definition: Relation edges are real (endpoints in the rendered set), typed and reachable on selection.

absolute_bar.note: REPORTED, not enforced. The absolute bar is reported, not enforced here: enforcement is the accepted bar gate's and Core Evaluation's.

regression_verdict.predicate: lineage := (set(per_bundle) == the three incumbent qids); regressed_qids := [qid in per_bundle where lineage AND n_pass < incumbent_count(qid)]; FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND regressed_qids non-empty; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND empty; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage
regression_verdict.note: Geometry regressions block on ANY packet carrying the three frozen qids regardless of decision count.

non_vacuity.proven_condition: best >= 2 flips AND some corrupted geometry reads overall FAIL
non_vacuity.movability_note: Under C-charter (cluster ids permuted across rows + labels permuted across cluster ids) only COHERENCE_QUERY_LANG, COHERENCE_QUERY_TERM and STRUCTURE_SEP can move; the other 8 read only x/y, the pooled label multiset, the cluster-size multiset, the relation list or the outlier flags, all of which that permutation provably preserves.

marginal_discovery.definition: For every issued counter/contrary authority row: whether its decision_id was absent from the initial-pool top-K, its least-ranked list position, and whether a jurist scanning the ranked list would encounter it before the map.
marginal_discovery.frozen_K_definition: Top-K of the initial ranked list (before any map rendering or clustering). K=20 is the pre-registered gate's route to a positive q1/q3 (count of SUPPORTED rows outside conventional top-20).
marginal_discovery.counter_authority_definition: counter_status not in gate_admissibility.NON_COUNTER_STATUSES (excludes cited / supporting-candidate / context / unclassified / none)

measurement.absent_from_initial_top_k: decision_id not in first K ranked decisions of initial pool
measurement.least_ranked_list_position: the rank value of the row in the initial ranked list
measurement.map_encounter_before_list: whether the map structure would surface this decision before a jurist scanning the ranked list reaches its position

serve_conditions.label_bar_met: support_rate == 1.0 on primary population (n_scored > 0 AND n_supported == n_scored)
serve_conditions.geometry_bar_met: all 11 criteria pass on all 3 bundles (n_bundles_pass_all_11 == 3)
serve_conditions.mega_cluster_disclosure_fires: size-based largest-cluster share >= 0.5 on all 3 bundles
serve_conditions.note: The abstain-and-disclose classifier's honest zero at n_scored=0 is not a 1.0 and not a pass. A QUERY_MAP_MVP section 7 minimum-semantics assessment may be REPORTED as a measurement and may never be used as a serve criterion.

bounded_negative.condition: both frozen absolute bars remain unmet and no in-budget fix exists
bounded_negative.note: converts the map-versus-ranked-list choice into ONE explicit owner product decision ONLY IF its own record carries an explicit owner_decision_required=true

do_not_serve_unchanged.condition: bars remain unmet as written and the serve conclusion is unchanged
